eligibility.summary: The NOFO has three components: Component A, Component B, and Component C. Eligible applicants may apply for only one component. If an applicant submits multiple applications, all applications submitted by that applicant will be deemed non-responsive, and will not receive further review. In the "Descriptive Title of Applicant's Project" on In North Carolina, eligible entities fitting the organizational requirements may apply.

cost_share.details: No cost sharing or non-federal matching funds are required.

review_criteria.criterion: Work Plan Feasibility and Milestone Schedule

submission_limits: Institutional limits apply as detailed in the opportunity announcement; verify internal screening procedures.
important_notes: Opportunity Number: CDC-RFA-DD-27-0028 — Agency: Centers for Disease Control - NCBDDD.
Forecasted Opportunity: This is an advance forecast notice. Official application packages and final closing dates will be released upon posting.
Application submission is administered via Grants.gov or the designated federal portal for opportunity CDC-RFA-DD-27-0028.
SAM.gov registration must be active with valid Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) prior to submission; allow 3-4 weeks for new registrations.
Review all instructions, eligibility requirements, and deadlines published on Grants.gov before preparing submission.
